prompt: I work night shifts and I'm exhausted and can't sleep well. According to This Is Your Brain on Food, which foods help with sleep and with fatigue, and what should I avoid?
assertions: Lists melatonin-containing foods (e.g. tart cherry, eggs, fish, milk, oats, grapes, pomegranates, walnuts) and/or tryptophan with carbohydrates for sleep
Mentions chamomile tea and omega-3 fatty fish for sleep
For fatigue, recommends anti-inflammatory foods/polyphenols, magnesium and zinc, B vitamins, and capsaicin-rich chili peppers
Advises keeping caffeine under 400 mg/day and no caffeine after 3 p.m.
Notes that alcohol may help you fall asleep but disrupts sleep
Explains the circadian rhythm / gut bacteria connection and how night shifts or jet lag disrupt it
